fusions.name: Upturned Ground
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 14 damage and is thrown back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dirt Toss
fusions.desc: Flings a clod that deals 4 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times its damage at maximum range. It has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Raise Mound
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of earth 6 tiles long that blocks the way for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Footing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
